name: Forced displacement
summary: About 50,000 fled Ethiopia clashes into Kenya since late Oct; Yemen and Darfur flight go on; none over 500,000/month
state: IOM said on 9 Nov that about 50,000 people have crossed into Moyale in northern Kenya since late October, fleeing clashes in Ethiopia's Oromia and Somali regions (UN News via AllAfrica). IOM said on 12 Nov that more than 5,200 people fled villages in North and South Darfur over three days (Anadolu via A News), and earlier counted over 300,000 displaced in western Yemen over two months (Khaleej Times, citing AFP). None reaches 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: These events mainly affect people in the regions concerned. UNHCR and IOM publish displacement figures; FCDO travel advice covers affected countries.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing >500,000 in a month (largest found: ~50,000 into Kenya since late Oct; 300,000+ in Yemen over two months)
